The program experience

Ask during the session.
Keep learning afterward.

A question can come up while you are watching a demonstration or later when you practise. Your program gives you ways to ask, find resources, and prepare for the next session.

Explore programs↗
Before your session

Know where to be and what to bring.

Prepare from one program page

Check the full schedule, requirements, and shared materials. Online sessions show a timezone. In-person programs include location details.

Keep up with changes

Read your provider’s announcements for official updates. Session reminders help you keep track of what is coming up, and your dashboard points to the next session.

During an online session

Ask about the step
you did not follow.

The provider starts the session from the program schedule. You join from the same place, with your camera, microphone, and session chat in the room.

Watch a shared screen in stage view or see the people in the session in a grid. You can switch your microphone and speaker, turn your camera off, or use fullscreen when you want to focus.

If the connection drops, the room tries to reconnect. Access is limited to the provider and confirmed seekers.

After a session

Find your program files and schedule

Program resources

Download program materials

Providers can share documents, slides, spreadsheets, images, audio, video, and other supporting files. Confirmed seekers download those resources from the program. For a repeating series, one shared library serves its different dates.

Open the program page to find the files your provider has shared.

Schedule & reminders

Know what is coming up

The program lists its sessions, and your dashboard shows the next one. Reminders are sent before program and when it starts. Program updates and cancellations have their own notifications.

Online schedules carry a timezone. Read it when choosing a program, especially if the provider is in another part of the world.

In person, too

Attend a program
in person.

For a hands-on workshop, a shared space can be part of the experience. talent-share also supports in-person programs, with a venue, address, and session schedule.

You can still access your booking, program files, provider announcements, and program discussion from the program page. Check the materials list so you arrive with what you need.

Your account

Use one account to learn and teach

You do not need a second account to move between learning and teaching. Apply to become a provider from the account you already use. Once approved, your learning and teaching dashboards keep the two kinds of activity organised.

Your learning view holds upcoming, in-progress, and completed programs. Your teaching view brings together programs, seekers, the calendar, messages, and reports. You can switch between the two views in the same account.

you want to join.

Check the provider, level, and schedule before you book. You can explore public program pages without an account.
